segments.text: In this programme, we're talking about money. And Beth, as the old saying goes, money makes the world go round.

segments.text: You mean it's very important and lots of things couldn't happen without it.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Well, we all need money. But have you noticed how our money doesn't seem to buy so much these days?
segments.fa: خب، همه‌مون به پول نیاز داریم. اما متوجه شدی که پول‌مون این روزها دیگه چیزهای زیادی نمی‌خره؟

segments.text: Yes, I have, Beth. It seems like consumers, like us, are being hit in the pocket at the moment.

segments.speaker: Beth

segments.speaker: Rob
segments.text: It's a big problem globally. And Beth, my question for you is about inflation. According to one report, what was the annual inflation rate in Venezuela between November 2017 and 2018? Was it a. 130%? b. 1,300%? or c. 1,300,000%?

segments.speaker: Beth

segments.text: Even if you take out some of these volatile items like food and energy,
